Large, soft, slouchy leather top-handle bag with a fold-over flap, belted warm-gold closure, two upright rolled handles and a detachable shoulder strap. Intended material specification: vegetable-tanned leather; factory must confirm leather type, grade, thickness and tanning documentation. Natural grain and matte-to-satin body finish with smoother trim. Preserve braided upper-edge trim, lower corner caps, horizontal oval center plate, paired flat-bar side fittings, key bell and inward-draping belt tails. No logos or third-party branding.

Four colorways: Chocolate (dark body with warmer cognac contrast trim), Cognac, Black and Olive. Chocolate is the approved design master. Final Black/Olive trim and all factory color swatches require approval.

Nominal design dimensions: 38 cm top width x 27 cm body height x 20 cm depth; 10 cm handle drop; detachable strap target 100-115 cm adjustable. These are owner-approved design targets, NOT physical sample measurements. Factory must supply a dimensioned drawing and measured first article. Interior, lining, pockets, base construction, exact closure assembly and usable capacity require sample confirmation. No laptop-fit claim is established.

Positioning: understated everyday luxury, tactile leather, relaxed silhouette, distinctive warm-gold detailing and versatile hand/forearm/long-strap carry.
